text: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.customers

text: How many products are currently active?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.products p WHERE p.active

text: How many orders were placed in 2025, whatever their status?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'

text: How many orders have been cancelled, in total?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

text: What was our total revenue in 2025, counting only shipped orders and taking each line's discount off?
sql: SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'

text: What is the average unit price, from the product list, of our active products?
sql: SELECT avg(p.unit_price) FROM sqlmcp_test.products p WHERE p.active

text: How many wholesale customers are there in the North region?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.customers c JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.name = 'North' AND c.segment = 'wholesale'

text: Of all our products, active or not, which has the highest unit price?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM sqlmcp_test.products p ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT unit_price AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.products), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 1), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 2)

text: Which region had the most shipped orders placed in 2025?
sql:
SELECT r.name FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id
WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT count(*) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id
WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY r.name), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 1), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 2)

text: What was the revenue from shipped orders placed in 2025, after discounts, for each region?
sql:
SELECT r.name, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id
WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name

text: What are our three best-selling products, by total quantity sold in shipped orders?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.products p ON p.id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sum(ol.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT sum(ol.quantity) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.products p ON p.id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY p.name), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 3), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 4)

text: Which customer has placed the most orders, counting orders of any status?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT count(*) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 1), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 2)

text: How many customers have never placed an order of any status?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

text: What was the average value of shipped orders placed in the first quarter of 2026, where an order's value is the sum of its lines after discounts?
sql: SELECT avg(x.v) FROM (SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS v FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY o.id) x

text: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue from shipped orders, after discounts? Answer as YYYY-MM.
sql: SELECT to_char(o.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) DESC LIMIT 1

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY to_char(o.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM')), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 1), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 2)

text: What percentage of the orders placed in 2025 were returned?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'returned') / count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'

text: What was the revenue from shipped orders placed in 2025, after discounts, for each product category?
sql:
SELECT p.category, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.products p ON p.id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

text: How many different products appear in orders placed by the customer Harbour Foods, of any status?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ol.product_id) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Harbour Foods'

text: Which regions' revenue from shipped orders, after discounts, beat their revenue target in the fourth quarter of 2025?
sql:
SELECT x.name FROM (WITH rev AS (SELECT c.region_id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS revenue FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY c.region_id)
SELECT r.name, rev.revenue, t.revenue_target FROM rev JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = rev.region_id
JOIN sqlmcp_test.targets t ON t.region_id = rev.region_id AND t.year = 2025 AND t.quarter = 4) x WHERE x.revenue > x.revenue_target ORDER BY x.name

tie.sql:
SELECT greatest(x.revenue, x.revenue_target), least(x.revenue, x.revenue_target) FROM (WITH rev AS (SELECT c.region_id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS revenue FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY c.region_id)
SELECT r.name, rev.revenue, t.revenue_target FROM rev JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = rev.region_id
JOIN sqlmcp_test.targets t ON t.region_id = rev.region_id AND t.year = 2025 AND t.quarter = 4) x

text: By how much did the East region's revenue from shipped orders, after discounts, exceed its revenue target in the third quarter of 2025? Give a negative number if it fell short.
sql:
SELECT x.revenue - x.revenue_target FROM (WITH rev AS (SELECT c.region_id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS revenue FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY c.region_id)
SELECT r.name, rev.revenue, t.revenue_target FROM rev JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = rev.region_id
JOIN sqlmcp_test.targets t ON t.region_id = rev.region_id AND t.year = 2025 AND t.quarter = 3) x WHERE x.name = 'East'

text: How many orders are there in each status?
sql: SELECT o.status::text, count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY 1

text: In 2025, how much money did discounts take off our shipped orders?
sql: SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * ol.discount_rate) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'

text: What is the average quantity per order line, across all orders?
sql: SELECT avg(ol.quantity) FROM sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol

text: On which day of the week were the most shipped orders placed?
sql: SELECT to_char(o.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDay') FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT count(*) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY to_char(o.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDay')), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 1), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 2)

text: How many orders, of any status, were placed on 1 March 2026, in Johannesburg time?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o WHERE (o.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date = '2026-03-01'

text: By what percentage did revenue from shipped orders, after discounts, grow from the third quarter to the fourth quarter of 2025?
sql: SELECT 100 * ((SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00') - (SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00')) / (SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00')

text: How many customers joined in 2026?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlmcp_test.customers c WHERE c.joined_on >= '2026-01-01'

text: What was the 2025 revenue from shipped orders, after discounts, for retail customers and for wholesale customers?
sql:
SELECT c.segment::text, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY 1

text: Which products have never been ordered, in an order of any status?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM sqlmcp_test.products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol WHERE ol.product_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.name

tie.sql: SELECT min(n), 0 FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM sqlmcp_test.order_lines GROUP BY product_id) x

text: Which shipped order has the highest value, after discounts? Give its order id.
sql: SELECT o.id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

text: What was the median value, after discounts, of shipped orders placed in 2025?
sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.value) FROM (SELECT o.id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY o.id) x

text: Which product category had the second-highest revenue from shipped orders placed in 2025, after discounts?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.products p ON p.id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1

(WITH v AS (SELECT sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN sqlmcp_test.products p ON p.id = ol.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY p.category), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)

text: How many customers in the South region have more than 10 shipped orders?
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT c.id FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sqlmcp_test.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id
WHERE r.name = 'South' AND o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY c.id HAVING count(*) > 10) x

text: On average, how many whole days after joining do customers place their first order of any status?
sql:
SELECT avg((f.first_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - c.joined_on) FROM sqlmcp_test.customers c
JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, min(o.placed_at) AS first_at FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o GROUP BY o.customer_id) f ON f.customer_id = c.id

text: What percentage of 2025's revenue from shipped orders, after discounts, came from the ten customers with the most such revenue?
sql:
WITH cr AS (SELECT o.customer_id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY o.customer_id)
SELECT 100 * (SELECT sum(t.value) FROM (SELECT cr.value FROM cr ORDER BY cr.value DESC LIMIT 10) t) / (SELECT sum(cr.value) FROM cr)

tie.sql:
WITH v AS (SELECT o.customer_id, sum(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_rate)) AS value FROM sqlmcp_test.orders o JOIN sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY o.customer_id), r AS (SELECT value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS n FROM v)
SELECT (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 10), (SELECT value FROM r WHERE n = 11)

text: How many orders, of any status, have more than three lines?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT ol.order_id FROM sqlmcp_test.order_lines ol GROUP BY ol.order_id HAVING count(*) > 3) x
